crossRefs.note: Of the children of Issachar, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of…
those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Issachar, were fifty-four thousand four hundred.
Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Issachar. The prince of the children of Issachar shall be Nethanel…
His division, and those who were counted of it, were fifty-four thousand four hundred.

people.name: Issachar
people.line: Son of Jacob and Leah, forefather of tribe

translations.web: These are the families of Issachar according to those who were counted of them, sixty-four thousand three hundred.
translations.bsb: These were the clans of Issachar, and their registration numbered 64,300.
translations.kjv: These are the families of Issachar according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and four thousand and three hundred.
translations.asv: These are the families of Issachar according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and four thousand and three hundred.
